porous_transport.note: Historical through P30: Darcy and mixture-diffusion relations from existing gas_transport.py and pore source records. Common molar-frame D, viscosity power laws and evolving brick properties are assumed. No Knudsen or Soret prediction; reciprocal-logarithmic carried-enthalpy mean preserves the stated ideal-gas entropy inequality. P31 host mode1 now adds separately sourced wall friction; all pore geometry and material applicability remain assumed. Current P31mode1 uses coupled wall/Maxwell-Stefan friction; legacy pair zero-total constraint and beta resistance are inactive. No Soret or measured pore accuracy.

quartz_nist.note: Existing local source. Source alpha/beta Cp, 847 K transition, 728 J/mol rounded JANAF latent increment. Metastable quartz extrapolation across actual high-T polymorph region remains an approximation.

solid_effective.note: Thermodynamic free-energy construction reused in an axial effective skeleton. Modulus, background expansion and quartz transition eigenstrain are explicit engineering assumptions, not measured brick properties. The transition eigenstrain follows the existing caloric phase fraction and initial quartz reference-volume fraction; not a pure-phase molar-volume or stress-dependent equilibrium law. USGS volumes at different temperatures cannot identify the isothermal phase jump.

effective_conductivity.note: Engineering closure for effective dry-solid connectivity and liquid pore filling, not a measured homogenization law. Fourier transport uses positive state-dependent k and series half-cell resistances; no extra stored or reaction energy. Exponent and liquid-volume gain are uncalibrated assumptions. Initial dry reference fraction is derived from root recipe and constituent molar volumes.

lumped_carbonization.note: Explicit engineering CH2O -> C + H2O pathway using existing proxy species, atom-balanced stoichiometry and the same formation enthalpy/entropy reference. Not a fitted sludge pyrolysis spectrum. Arrhenius coefficients and common reactivity of initial/generated char are assumed; no new independent reaction heat.

effective_liquid_phase.note: Engineering fluxed-matrix proxy carried by a fraction of current metakaolin, with unchanged Al2Si2O7 composition and molar volume. Two-state free energy gives equilibrium liquid fraction, latent enthalpy and entropy; these parameters are not pure metakaolin melting properties, measured mineral fractions or a phase diagram. The current host adds finite-rate phase relaxation and retained-disorder proxy on cooling; this is not a measured quenched-glass fraction, crystallization kinetics, or a mineral phase diagram.

pore_radiation.note: Declared local equilibrium pore-wall radiation closure: k_rad=4*sigma*exchange_factor*current_pore_diameter*gas_porosity*T^3. The factor represents unmeasured wall exchange and geometry, not a spectral emissivity measurement. Pore diameter inherits the assumed sintering-radius geometry; no independent optical length or spectral transport.

liquid_water_transport.note: Declared Onsager liquid-water closure with availability-weighted positive mobility and shared transported enthalpy. Mechanical potential is supplemented by the separately declared water_retention free energy in the current model. No wetting hysteresis or measured hydraulic conductivity. The diffusivity-dimensional coefficient is a mobility scale, not a measured Fick diffusivity.

water_retention.note: Ideal-mixing free energy RT*[n*ln(n/(n+N))+N*ln(N/(n+N))]. Current immobile equivalents N follow water_site_evolution; neither an extra mass inventory nor measured capacity. U_mix=0; entropy composition derivatives with respect to water and carrier are both retained. Energetic binding is separately declared.

water_phase_exchange.note: Declared seeded phase kinetics: both signed directions oppose the same water/vapor chemical-potential difference and share the evaporation Arrhenius rate. Bounded driving functions give finite log-inventory rates. Reverse prefactor proportional to existing liquid; no exactly dry nucleation, measured condensation law or resolved interface area. At unit factor paired one-way flux ratio exp(-affinity).

liquid_relaxation.note: Declared nonequilibrium extension of the existing two-state free energy: log-odds q relaxes toward its equilibrium value, with positive Arrhenius rate. Carrier birth inherits local disordered fraction; phase energy and entropy derivatives are explicit. No measured glass-transition or crystallization kinetics. Current matrix eigenstrain adds the phase_eigenstrain elastic affinity to the kinetic target; the caloric q_eq remains the stress-free reference.

water_binding.note: Declared saturating water-binding Helmholtz energy g(n)*a(T), g=N*n/(n+N); a=-E+C*(T-Tr-T*ln(T/Tr)). Positive excess capacity and convex composition free energy. Coefficients are engineering assumptions, not measured sorption heats.

gas_program.note: Predeclared virtual kiln reservoir composition at thermal-stage endpoints, linearly interpolated with process time. No plant atmosphere measurements, kiln circulation/combustion solution or recipe optimization.

water_site_evolution.note: Declared immobile site equivalents N=N0*(r+(1-r)*n_kaolin/n_kaolin_initial). A persistent fraction r remains after dehydroxylation; r is unmeasured and positive over the declared domain, not an inventory floor. Composition derivatives of the existing mixing and binding free energies enter kaolin reaction affinity and caloric/entropy ledgers. No site regeneration, independent kinetics, measured site count or sintering loss.

reversible_carbonate.note: Phenomenological reverse carbonate reaction uses the existing decarbonation Arrhenius rate, local CaO inventory, dimensionless CO2 pressure and the same pure-phase affinity. No measured reverse kinetics or product-layer model; a conserved calcite/lime inventory permits regeneration at either pure-phase endpoint.

structure_viscosity.note: Declared activated effective axial rheology: ordered active-matrix dry-volume fraction raises the barrier by E_order*phi_ordered. Existing disordered-volume gain is retained as a prefactor. No measured melt viscosity, glass transition, separate crystal kinetics, new storage or additional heat source.

porosity_stiffness.note: Declared power of dry-solid volume fraction, derived within the existing axial Helmholtz skeleton; no measured porous modulus law.

phase_eigenstrain.note: Effective axial eigenstrain B=a*N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0 of the finite-rate matrix proxy. Same Helmholtz energy supplies phase driving force and composition derivatives. No measured phase volume jump, mineral equilibrium or damage. Nonzero amplitude with active carrier requires positive relaxation time; algebraic stress-coupled phase equilibrium is outside this closure.

phase_stiffness.note: Reference-volume weighted log-modulus contrast of the existing ordered/disordered matrix proxy: K=K_porosity*exp(-g*C), C=N*v_matrix*(x-x_ref)/V0. Same Helmholtz energy supplies phase, carrier and mechanical derivatives. No measured phase modulus, glass transition, damage or phase-resolved mixture law.

phase_heat_capacity.note: Constant two-state Cp contrast: dh=L+c*(T-Tm), ds=L/Tm+c*ln(T/Tm), q_eq=(ds-dh/T)/b. State storage, carrier chemical potential and internal relaxation share this free energy. Nominal c=10 J/mol/K is an illustrative assumed increment, not a literature or measured value.

phase_conductivity.note: Effective dry-skeleton log conductivity contrast: multiply the dry term by exp(-gk*phi_disordered), with phi_disordered=N*x*v_matrix/V_dry. Water enhancement and pore radiation stay separate. Nominal gk=2 and signed range [-4,4] are illustrative assumptions, not measured constituent conductivities or a material-specific direction.

porosity_diffusion.note: Effective face transport tortuosity tau=1+(tau_initial-1)*(phi_initial/phi)^a with the preceding arithmetic gas porosity. a=1 and range [0,2] are illustrative assumptions, not a measured geometric or connected-pore law. Positive common-D, shared flux and conjugate carried enthalpy preserve the same entropy construction. No extra storage or Knudsen/percolation model.

pair_diffusion.note: Historical through P30: Positive symmetric pair mobility preserves zero total molecular molar flux and pair entropy structure. P24 water pairs use source tables/ABC from binary_diffusion_background; three legacy water factors are inactive. Only three nonwater pairs retain assumed common Dref/temperature exponent and their relative factors. Pore resistance, tortuosity and finite mixture/pressure extensions are assumed; no full Maxwell-Stefan inversion, Knudsen or Soret qualification. P27 retained current nonwater law after the bounded original-source audit. Current P31mode1 uses coupled wall/Maxwell-Stefan friction; legacy pair zero-total constraint and beta resistance are inactive. No Soret or measured pore accuracy.

mixture_viscosity.note: Current P20 uses root viscosity_background pure zero-density source curves and same-temperature Wilke Phi, with symmetric face composition. Mixing interpolation, finite mixture/pore application and source-domain extrapolation remain assumed. Historical four pure reference factors and shared temperature-power law were removed as active controls. Wilke equation was checked in official IDAES documentation; original Wilke full text was not verified.
